name: Babydoll
source:
Even adult women sometimes pretend to be innocent little devils. It's not that they want to stay young forever, but they just can't hide essence of their charms. Babydoll is a nightwear that has a girlish taste. This is a collection of stories about such playful girls in babydoll.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
